criteria.text: Ten parallel local checks with PDD_MAX_JOBS=3 all finish with at most 3 runtime jobs active at once.
Tests, remote lint and Simulator setup share an explicit PDD_MAX_JOBS=4 local limit across repositories and worktrees.
pdd reuses a dead process's slot only after its runtime jobs are confirmed ended or after 30 minutes.
Stopping a command preserves slots for dispatched jobs that have not been confirmed ended.
Waiting tickets, active owners and claim locks refresh about every 5 seconds; after 60 seconds without refresh, a reused live process ID cannot keep them alive.
SIGHUP and SIGTERM remove my waiting ticket and claim locks, while preserving dispatched jobs whose end is unconfirmed.
Checking a dead owner never holds the local claim lock during a runtime read, and repeated checks reuse each job observation for about 15 seconds.

cases.given: 10 commands, limit 3, fake runtime tracks active jobs
cases.required_observation: all pass, measured maximum 3; no busy failure

cases.given: several repos/worktrees; PDD_MAX_JOBS=4; test batches, lint, Simulator setup
cases.required_observation: shared cap 4; no parent reservation deadlock; browser session lifetime takes no slot

cases.given: dead PID; running, unknown, missing and wrong-ID receipts separately
same-ID terminal jobs, separately age 1800000 ms
cases.required_observation: reservation reusable; age 1799999 ms with running job remains occupied

cases.given: pending posted job, separately confirmed terminal and unsent job
cases.required_observation: retain pending; release ended/unsent; no extra dispatch

cases.given: fake clock and timers; waiting ticket, active reservation and held claim separately; live owner refreshes every 5000 ms for 65000 ms
cases.required_observation: each owned file stays fresh while owned, including during slow outside work; no premature owner expiry; stopping ownership cancels timers and does not recreate removed files; listing keeps exactly its existing public fields

cases.given: native temporary files and a genuine acquired active reservation; replace its file before registration with a same-ID/PID active record whose kind, started_at or complete ordered request_ids differs, separately each field, request-list reordering and combined; also vary pid or state; retain the original reservation reference; use native default heartbeat timers in a separate check
cases.required_observation: registration throws finite local-state-unavailable and leaves foreign bytes, request IDs and refresh time unchanged; a later heartbeat cannot refresh or adopt the replacement; validation occurs under the existing claim immediately before the update; no POST is authorized

cases.given: native acquisition promotes its waiting record, then request IDs paid-one, paid-two, paid-one are registered through separately resolved native ports; separately register and release a valid saved/adopted reference to an existing active record without a local acquisition; also retain existing injected-files callers
cases.required_observation: valid registration succeeds, request IDs remain [paid-one,paid-two] in order and the original live heartbeat still refreshes after the writes; promotion remains owned; plain id/directory references and existing port bindings need no new token or local-owner gate; ended false stops refreshes and preserves the uncertain lease

cases.given: native acquired reservation replaced by a same-ID/PID foreign active record before ended true release, ended false release, or synchronized SIGINT/SIGHUP/SIGTERM cleanup; separately ended false release retains the original record, then a foreign replacement precedes ended true on the same returned reservation object; separately replace an owned waiting ticket or claim before its cleanup
cases.required_observation: each old owner stops its refresh work and removes its listeners without unlinking, modifying or refreshing the foreign replacement; a changed/replaced claim cannot authorize admission or registration and its foreign successor survives cleanup; same-object ownership evidence survives ended false without retaining released references or restarting heartbeats; confirmation about the original job never releases the replacement; ordinary own ended/unsent cleanup still works

cases.given: active record with a stale heartbeat/file refresh and an unrelated live process at its PID; request running, unknown, missing, wrong-ID and unreadable separately; lease ages 1799999 and 1800000 ms
cases.required_observation: owner expires at 60000 ms without refresh despite live PID; active reservation retained at age 1799999 for every unconfirmed end; reclaim at 1800000; confirmed all-ended or unsent may reclaim earlier

cases.given: existing waiting, active and claim records without explicit heartbeat metadata; file refresh age 59999 then 60000 ms; PID appears alive
cases.required_observation: file refresh supplies freshness; not expired at 59999, expired at 60000; expired active paid/unknown lease still obeys 30-minute/end rule; no indefinite PID-only ownership

cases.given: separate child commands receive SIGHUP and SIGTERM while waiting, while holding a claim, and after a potentially dispatched request
cases.required_observation: remove only own waiting ticket and claim; no later ID recording or POST; preserve every uncertain dispatched active record and request ID; confirmed-ended/unsent release remains allowed

cases.given: dead active owner with one request; fake authenticated GET deliberately blocked; another admitted command records its request ID during the blocked probe
cases.required_observation: GET begins with no claim held; the other registration completes while probe is pending; no network request occurs inside any claim critical section

cases.given: one process repeatedly inspects the same dead owner/request at 0, 100, 14999 and 15000 ms; run running, unknown and thrown-read variants separately
cases.required_observation: one read through 14999 ms, next read eligible at 15000 ms; unknown/read failure never turns into ended; distinct origin/port, command or request ID does not reuse the observation

cases.given: probe reports ended, but before reclamation the owner refreshes, another request ID is appended, or the record identity is replaced; variants separately
cases.required_observation: recheck under exclusion rejects each stale snapshot; no removal based on the old answer and no loss of new request ID or successor record

cases.given: real child producer writes its PID through a plain string with FORCE_COLOR=3, records a request and exits; later acquisition reads running then ended
cases.required_observation: PID parse is a valid uncolored positive integer; actual producer exit is observed; retain running lease, reclaim only after ended or existing lease boundary
